title: Framer – No Code Website Builder
description: Framer's live website is a visually stunning showcase of what the product itself can do. Uses massive typography with gradient text effects and animated UI elements showing real Framer components in action. Dynamic scroll-driven animations demonstrate the product capabilities in a meta way. The page toggles between dark and light modes, itself demonstrating Framer's theme-switching feature. Vibrant gradient palette with purple, pink, and blue transitions. Each section feels like a mini-demonstration of a different Framer capability.
primary_use_case: Live design inspiration for web builder platforms or creative tools that want to dogfood their own product capabilities on their marketing page.
style_vibe: Meta, bold, and animated — a page that dogfoods the product's own design capabilities in spectacular fashion.
